_doc: The scroll path of the submission video (npm run capture; --list prints the timeline). Seconds. 'hold' rests on each chapter and 'holds' overrides it per chapter; a move between two chapters takes 'scroll' seconds per screen height of the story's scroll track, and 'moves' overrides it per chapter left; 'rests' stops that long in the middle of the move leaving a chapter (the 'One day,' card after 'again'). The first chapter rests 'intro' seconds; the last 'final' seconds, its timeline (the light going out, the landing, the silence) at real-time pace. 'cursor' is the invisible scripted pointer per chapter hold: [seconds into the hold, x, y] in normalised device coordinates (-1..1, y up), a smooth curve through the keys, away before the first and after the last; 'press' holds the button down (as a touch does: the effect widens) over [from, to] seconds into the hold. 'seed' fixes the sound's random choices.
